title: Plan: recheck cpu_moe=41 plus top768 source-hidden exact hot residual
why_reopened: Raw top4096 residency and exact payload compression are rejected. The only fitting route with a prior positive 10 tok/s paper bound is not raw top768 alone; it is top768 exact hot residual combined with source/page overlap and cpu_moe=41, with all new source cost hidden.

hard_questions_before_code.question: Can the top768 direct prefill cost be hidden enough?
hard_questions_before_code.bound: Measured synchronous prefill is 1723.238 ms, while accepted TTFT slack is about 725 ms. At least about 998 ms must be overlapped or moved out of the accepted TTFT path.

hard_questions_before_code.question: Can exact top768 compute fit the overhead budget?
hard_questions_before_code.bound: The prior positive source-hidden bound has only 446.414 ms zero-overhead slack. The per-call Q8_0 CUDA path is already rejected, so only a batched/fused resident path can be considered.

hard_questions_before_code.question: Can correctness be proven before performance?
hard_questions_before_code.bound: CPU-compatible Q8_0 arithmetic has passed fixed-text top1 for all up/down, but any new batched/fused resident path must pass llama-results top1 before strict cold benchmarking.

hard_questions_before_code.question: Does cpu_moe=41 still preserve the accepted gate cache and 16GB host RAM/page-cache behavior?
hard_questions_before_code.bound: Use the existing top768 fit diagnostic as prior evidence, but any performance candidate must rerun under MemoryMax=16000000000 and MemorySwapMax=0.

immediate_next_action: Write a refreshed top768 source-hidden hard-bound using current microprobe, VRAM snapshot, direct prefill measurement, and Q8_0 overhead data. Do not implement runtime code unless it still shows a plausible >10 tok/s path or an explicitly intermediate >4.4 tok/s SOTA candidate.
